summary: BeyondSpring Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to 9,200,000 ordinary shares through agent Citizens JMP Securities, with a maximum aggregate offering price of about $11.94 million. Shares last traded at $0.7772 on September 25, 2026; the public float was roughly $41.8 million based on 35,750,770 non-affiliate shares at $1.17. Citizens earns up to 3.0% commission. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance given the sub-$1 price.
